About

Hi there!

AI ENGINEER / BUILDERAP.Aayush Purohit
Vidisha, Madhya PradeshAZURE
CERTIFIED

I build AI systems that can reason, act, and get things done — from collaborative agents and RAG pipelines to voice assistants that work completely offline.

I studied Computer Science Engineering with a Blockchain Technology specialization at Samrat Ashok Technological Institute, Vidisha (2022–2026).

At TestZeus, I built evaluation pipelines for the Hercules multi-agent system, bringing 300 Salesforce tasks into a structured benchmarking workflow.

As Founder and COO of AI On Call at Supernova, I worked on low-latency voice AI for environments where connectivity cannot be taken for granted.

My work also spans Java and Spring backends, multithreaded applications, cloud infrastructure, and automated deployments. I use tools such as Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes to connect application development with reliable infrastructure.
